problem_type: Async director output operation loses ownership before completion
symptom: Encoding releases the busy indicator, permits another recording, ignores cancellation after encoding starts and propagates frame-capture exceptions without a user error. A desktop screenshot with no saved asset url falls back to base64 and enters the persistent project.
direct_cause: Capture finally clears videoRecording before the encoding await, with one reusable cancellation boolean and no mounted lifetime.
class_root: A recording must own capture, encoding, cancellation and final registration as one task until it settles.
affected_population: Editor close during capture or encoding
internal_only_reason: Audited useDirectorOutputs, timeline/TimelineHeader, the top-bar deliver cluster and bridge/persistOutputs. The desktop IPC has no cancellation API, so late results must be discarded by the application task owner.
invariants: Only one output recording owns the timeline until capture and encoding settle
Cancelled or unmounted tasks never register outputs or show success
Capture and encoding errors resolve false with one error notification and release task state
Only durable desktop asset handles can be registered as persisted outputs; data/blob urls are rejected at the asset bridge
PIP rendering restores temporary visibility, viewport and scissor even when render throws
generality_proof: Every recording entry shares useDirectorOutputs. A per-operation cancellation token and mounted guard span all awaits; a single try/catch/finally owns busy state and playhead restoration. Screenshot persistence validates the final bridge result for every UI caller, so malformed desktop results cannot fall back into project data.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own recording task through capture, encode, register and cleanup
Validate durable saved asset handle before reporting desktop persistence success

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Timeline command consumes OutputsContext from the same hook
Top-bar deliver cluster screenshot command shares the same output hook and persistence lifetime guard (2026-09-09: moved from the deleted panels/BottomBar.tsx)
Both screenshot hotkey and toolbar call the same persistence bridge before addOutputImage

recurrence.reason: A recording must own capture, encoding, cancellation and final registration as one task until it settles.
same_class_scan: rg recordVideo / cancelRecording / setVideoRecording across director: inspected both controls, OutputsContext and bridge
Checked both captureFrame rejection and persistDirectorFramesVideo late completion/unmount populations
Checked desktop asset urls: missing, whitespace, data URI and blob URI; browser fallback has explicit localOnly=true and does not claim durable persistence

prevention.invariant: Only one output recording owns the timeline until capture and encoding settle; Cancelled or unmounted tasks never register outputs or show success; Capture and encoding errors resolve false with one error notification and release task state
prevention.failure_mode: Resolve false, discard late output, keep task exclusive until settle and restore playhead once.
prevention.strategy: Every recording entry shares useDirectorOutputs. A per-operation cancellation token and mounted guard span all awaits; a single try/catch/finally owns busy state and playhead restoration.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove reusable cancelRef and capture-only finally that releases ownership before encoding.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: React/three/desktop bridge remain unchanged; the application owns keyboard routing, coordinate contract and asynchronous operation lifetime.

migration: No persisted schema changes. Existing projects use the corrected runtime boundaries upon next open.
residual_risks: Desktop encoder cannot stop mid-IPC; cancellation discards its result but already-started encoding may finish and leave an unreferenced asset.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/useDirectorOutputs.ts 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
